# Invalid experience fixtures, and exactly why each must be rejected.
#
# One `filename|keyword|instancePath|missingProperty|reason` per line, with `-`
# for missingProperty when the keyword is not `required`. The test asserts
# the fixture fails with that keyword at that path (and, for `required`, that
# that exact property is the absent one).

api-version-unknown-shape.json|pattern|/apiVersion|-|apiVersion must be a versioned value
command-shell-string.json|pattern|/commands/0/executable|-|a command is an argument list, never a shell string
env-secret-looking-name-lowercase.json|pattern|/environment/env|-|environment variable names are uppercase by convention and shape
image-tag-not-digest.json|pattern|/environment/image|-|a tag is not an identity; images must be digest-pinned
policy-effect-allow.json|const|/policies/0/effect|-|a policy entry that widens rather than tightens must be unexpressible
resource-memory-out-of-range.json|maximum|/environment/resources/memoryMb|-|memory bounds are an invariant, not a hint
resources-partial.json|required|/environment/resources|pids|an omitted resource bound must fail rather than mean unbounded
secret-carries-value.json|additionalProperties|/secrets/0|-|an experience names a secret; it never carries one
unknown-top-level-field.json|additionalProperties|/|-|an unknown field must not be silently ignored
workdir-absolute.json|not|/environment/workdir|-|absolute paths are not expressible as a workdir
workdir-escapes-root.json|not|/environment/workdir|-|a relative path escaping the session root must be rejected at validation
